timing.estimand: Source-aggregated shifted-context MSE minus aligned-context MSE on identical targets; whole-body crop is a separate changed-target control
timing.internal_diagnostic: Post-selection normal diagnostic: the selected recipe used the same three internal folds. This is not independent confirmation
timing.interpretation: Time-aligned context sensitivity only. Finite crop marginals and configuration change; no physiological phase, disease simulation or causal interpretation
timing.support: Hip-only comparisons retain coverage but have no permitted distal edit; report them as uninformative for timing use
timing.timing_gate_note: The same operational two-of-three normal-fold adequacy rule is evaluated on each exact paired-support original input. It changes interpretation, not frozen models or scores
timing.uncertainty: 1000 bootstrap draws over unique source records, conditional on frozen models, selected recipe, split and budget; repeated inner-source model rows averaged first
timing.zero_correction: Frozen zero-gate rows remain included; zero timing response from such a model is mechanically guaranteed

verification.scope: core data, models, raw predictions, source aggregation and metrics; extensions separately audited

claims.learned_context: All12 GAVD operational internal gates passed; uniform-bank outer-normal benefit remains uncertain for U and A.
claims.mask_novelty: Known tube families, controlled budgets and marginal probabilities; no new mask-family claim.
claims.timing: Coverage passes but every exact-paired-support adequacy gate fails. No reliable coordination interpretation.
claims.detection: Fixed fusion lowers AUROC relative to the local channel in GAVD and the independent laboratory replication.
claims.external: Participant-separated six-angle method replication, not transfer of video weights or clinical validation.

aggregation.GAVD: mask draws within identical targets, targets within windows, windows within sequences, sequences within source/joint, eight readout joints equally within source; normalized xy squared coordinates
aggregation.external: mask draws within identical targets, targets within windows, windows within participant/angle, six angles equally within participant; native squared degrees

inference.relative_gain: difference of weighted mean losses divided by weighted mean comparator loss, not mean of individual ratios
inference.resampling: paired evaluation units within each original outer fold; fixed original normal-count fold weights
inference.scope: Conditional on the fitted models, retained units, masks, folds and chosen descriptive comparisons. Not training uncertainty or a prospective primary test.

scientific_limits: Matched residual input width does not imply equal effective capacity: external own/both design ranks are 44/62.
Completion improvements do not establish intrinsic information, neurological causation, disease diagnosis, or improved anomaly discrimination.
GAVD units are recording sources, not verified independent people; all normal sources were previously explored.
Both GAVD fixed banks are reported, with paired identical target identities and mask draw counts.

editorial_status: post-outcome positive interpretation; original primary results unchanged
